classification.justification: Paid plan includes Reporting; two users lack the permission because of their role.
classification.summary: After upgrading Starter to Pro, two employees still cannot open Reporting.

proposal.draft_reply:
Hi Maya,

Your account moved from Starter to Pro yesterday and Pro includes Reporting. A plan upgrade does not change existing roles: Jordan Patel and Priya Nair still have the Viewer role, which cannot open Reporting. An Admin can change them to Analyst in Settings > Users & Roles; it applies on their next page load.

Best regards,
Northstar Support

citations.claim: A plan upgrade does not change existing roles; Admins change roles.
